decision: Use the shipped Phase 1 Poke tokens and SPEC-POKE.md as the design contract
why: The user fixed the visual system and screen structure, so a new direction exercise would add no value

decision: Use the project-local TypeScript compiler when npx cannot start
why: npx exits in the macOS Keychain before TypeScript runs

decision: Keep route-local loaders and add pure schedule helpers plus reusable sheet and calendar components
why: This follows the existing repository and dataVersion boundary without duplicating SQLite state

decision: Fixed all six review findings and replaced raw reminder text with an inline time control
why: Each finding now has one owning component or screen

decision: Moved four routes into Expo Router Tabs and replaced the seal with a 56 px center add button
why: Router-owned navigation fixes web history and makes the final information architecture reachable

decision: Rebuilt Today around one medication summary and two quick-log tiles
why: The estimate, countdown, due state, and latest logs now come from repositories and pure domain helpers

decision: Added four 56 px log actions and a working side-effect destination
why: Every center-sheet row is one tap from its writer

decision: Rebuilt shot logging around a prefilled draft and saved rotation suggestion
why: The default path now needs only confirmation while exact time and notes stay optional

decision: Embedded the month grid in History and grouped list rows by day
why: Calendar selection now filters one shared shot list and the separate route is gone

decision: Added weight ranges, goal percentage, shot streaks, and conditional side-effect counts
why: Every metric is derived from stored measurements, schedules, and logs

decision: Reduced Profile to medications, reminders, units, goal, and disclaimer
why: The requested list is complete and no export behavior exists to preserve

decision: Deleted the seal, calendar route, Americana components, aliases, and Fraunces dependency
why: All callers now use Poke tokens and sentence-case labels

decision: Restyled report headers, ranges, labels, and chart colors without changing their data flow
why: Reports remain working card routes and inherit the current theme

decision: Corrected the timing record for the preceding seven checkpoints
why: Their timestamps were projected instead of read from the clock; the actions and evidence are accurate, but those seven time cells are not

decision: Stopped the Expo web walkthrough before browser work
why: Metro and static export both exit before port 8084 opens because macOS Keychain returns SecItemCopyMatching failed -50

decision: Ran strict TypeScript, ESLint, package JSON parsing, and direct requirement scans
why: These checks can run without Metro and cover the final source artifact

decision: Removed loose route and error casts from touched code and reran the final gates
why: Typed routes and unknown errors keep the final implementation within the strict TypeScript contract

decision: Used a local source audit after two independent finish-review attempts stalled
why: The reviewer produced no result after two bounded attempts, so the final handoff must disclose the missing independent review
